# STY010 `inconsistent-array-declaration`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

A declaration has a `dimension` attribute and an entity with its own shape.

## Why

In `real, dimension(5) :: x, y(2)` the attribute does not apply to `y`: a reader sees `dimension(5)`
and assumes every entity has that shape. Declare entities with different shapes in separate
statements.

## Reported

```fortran
real, dimension(5) :: x, y(2)
```

## Preferred

```fortran
real, dimension(5) :: x
real :: y(2)
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[STY010] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = STY010` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `S261` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
